rounds.summary: One workflow per firm. 34 search and synthesis agents completed before the run was stopped to save budget: all four search lenses for Optiver, IMC and Virtu; three for Jane Street, HRT and Citadel Securities; two for Renaissance, D. E. Shaw, Two Sigma and Jump; one for XTX. Optiver, IMC and Virtu were synthesized inside their workflows; the other eight were synthesized afterwards from the saved evidence, with no further web searching. Adversarial critics and reconciliation did not complete for any firm.
DRW added through the full pipeline: four search lenses, synthesis, a source auditor and a consistency critic, then a reconciler. All 8 agents completed.
